# Compositions: Index

A composition is the spatial logic of a surface: where the focal object sits, how content relates to
the viewport, how it scrolls, and how it transforms on other devices. Compositions are independent of
visual direction: a "centered focus" can be playful, institutional, or technical.

Load this index, pick candidates by the surface's archetype and content, then load only that family
file. Several marketing and narrative compositions (long document, stat-led, workbench, manifesto,
index-first, split narrative, sticky feature stack, map/diagram, catalog, ecosystem index, component
playground) adapt page-shape ideas from the Hallmark project, rewritten here around product archetypes,
states, and responsive behavior (see the third-party notices file).

Choosing: start from the archetype and the P0 content, not from what looks modern. When two fit, pick
the one that puts the user's next action closest to where their attention already is.
